description_en: Modifies the configuration of a traffic mirror session
description_zh: 修改镜像会话的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-traffic-mirror-session-attribute --traffic-mirror-session-id tms-j6cla50buc44ap8tu0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTrafficMirrorSessionAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the traffic mirror session.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的镜像会话描述。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_session_description

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the traffic mirror session.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的镜像会话名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_session_name

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the configuration of the traffic mirror session is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改镜像会话的配置信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接修改镜像会话的配置信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror session to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的镜像会话的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_session_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the new traffic mirror destination
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的镜像目的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_target_id

parameters.help_en:
The new traffic mirror destination type. Valid values:

NetworkInterface: network interface controller (NIC).

SLB: private network load balancing instance
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的镜像目的类型，取值：

NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。

SLB：私网负载均衡实例
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_target_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the new traffic mirror filter
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的流量镜像筛选条件的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_id

parameters.help_en:
The new VXLAN network identifier (VNI) that is used to distinguish mirrored data from different traffic mirror sessions. Valid values: 0 to 16777215.
You can use the VNI to identify mirrored data from different sessions at the traffic mirror destination. You can specify a custom VNI or use a system-allocated value. If you want the system to randomly allocate a VNI, do not configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的指定VNI，用来区分不同的镜像流量，取值范围为0~16777215。
您可以通过VNI在镜像目的区分不同会话的镜像流量。您可以自定义VNI的值，也可以由系统随机分配该值。如果由系统随机分配，该参数无需配置
parameters.name: virtual_network_id

parameters.help_en:
The new priority of traffic mirror session. Valid values: 1 to 32766.
A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The priorities of traffic mirror sessions created by the same account in the same region must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的镜像会话的优先级，取值范围为1~32766。
数字越小，优先级越高。同一账号在同一个地域创建的镜像会话优先级不能重复
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The maximum length of the mirrored original packet, excluding the VXLAN header. Default value: 1500. Valid values: 64 to 8500. Unit: bytes.
The value of this parameter affects the length of packets received at the traffic mirror destination. For more information, see the mirrored packet length and MTU limits in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html.

This parameter is available only in specific regions. For more information, see the mirrored packet length parameter description in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207514.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定被镜像的原始报文长度（不包含VXLAN报文长度），默认值1500，取值范围：64～8500，单位：字节。
该参数的大小会影响镜像目的收到的报文长度，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html中的镜像报文长度和MTU限制。

该参数仅在部分地域可用，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207514.html中的镜像报文长度参数描述
parameters.name: packet_length

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the traffic mirror session. Valid values:

false (default): does not enable the traffic mirror session.

true: enables the traffic mirror session
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启流量会话，取值：

false（默认值）：不开启流量会话。

true：开启流量会话
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the traffic mirror session. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list. For information about the regions that support traffic mirroring, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.help_zh: 镜像会话的所属地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。关于流量镜像支持的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.name: region_id
